fields.gap: Property loss at temperature is datasheet-class only: H35 derates above 50 to 60 C, SiC is flat far above this range, and the aluminium family derates above about 150 C, not reached. No derate curves are pinned and the daily cycle fatigue of core and adhesive is not quantified.
fields.direction: Pin derate curves for the core and adhesive against the measured daily band; couple to NFI-016-CTE.
fields.effect: The scored five modes use room-temperature properties for a cycling structure.
